title: Special team to probe Supplyco ‘sugar scam’; 8 employees suspended so far
content: The team comprises senior Civil Supplies Corporation officials, including those from its Vigilance wing; seven employees were suspended on Tuesday over the alleged supply of non-subsidised sugar to a private company; Supplyco Vigilance inspection found that the sugar stock remained at the Perumbavoor depot while records showed otherwise

title: Data on de-reservation proposals not readily available, says DoPT amidst tussle with Scheduled Castes panel
content: DoPT says information on such proposals scattered across departments, Ministries; NCSC had earlier criticised Centre’s ‘incomplete’ proposals to fill reserved posts with general category candidates

title: Poet R. Mohan passes away
content: He was well known for Cholkkazhcha, a performance-cum-recital of Malayalam poems with acting and visual expressions, at cultural forums in Kozhikode

title: VMC cracks down on unhygienic conditions in Vijayawada eateries
content: Inspections in K.T. Road and B.R.P. Road areas find kitchen, toilet and drinking water violations; ₹2,000 fines imposed on three hotels, notices issued to two others

title: SCoR commissions Automatic Block Signalling on 22-km stretch in Vijayawada Division
content: ABS network between Gudur and Sri Venkateswarapalem expands to 76.53 route km, improving safety, line capacity and operational efficiency

title: Congress appeals to allies to stick to two stanzas of Vande Mataram
content: The Congress leader’s statement came after Omar Abdullah and Farooq Abdullah stood through the full rendition of the national song at the inaugural International Film Festival of Jammu and Kashmir in Srinagar

title: SRM University-AP signs Open Access agreement with Springer Nature
content: Agreement to cover Article Processing Charges for eligible research papers; initiative aimed at enhancing global visibility of research from the university’s scholars

title: Ex-officials say Census data must be confidential amid concerns over potential NPR, NRC links
content: Records show that in 1951, NRC was prepared across the country by 'copying' data from the Census schedules; the countrywide NRC was never published, except in undivided Assam, which at the time also included Manipur and Tripura

title: Students demonstrate scientific temper and mathematical talent at The Hindu In School Science Fest and Maths Olympiad
content: The programme was inaugurated by Mandya Circle Inspector Naveen Supekar at Gowri Shankara Kalyana Mantapa in Mandya

title: Intermediate Board urged to focus on competency-based assessment
content: PARAKH-NCERT CEO Indrani Bhaduri stresses questions that test understanding, application, analysis and reasoning; appreciates BIEAP’s adoption of ITMS

title: Manthan International School bus goes up in flames; parents demand answers, action
content: Parents urge Sangareddy district officials for an investigation into previous fire incidents and a full-fleet inspection, preservation of forensic evidence, and a safety assessment of fire detection and alarm systems, even in classrooms and other areas

title: NIA looking into whether Ukrainians, U.S. national were involved in UAPA offences: sources
content: In the charge sheet filed against the accused on Tuesday, NIA had not invoked Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA); however, sources say probe is on to determine whether they were engaged in activities prejudicial to India’s security

title: Rayalaseema faces severe water crisis amid strengthening El Nino
content: As per the official data till the first week of September, there is significant deficit in rainfall across the vast region; Annamayya district leads the deficit chart at 78.3% below normal

title: International antiques dealer Subash Kapoor, accused of idol thefts, to be handed over to Centre
content: Madras HC directed that Kapoor, held in a Tiruchi jail, be repatriated to Germany in accordance with India’s extradition treaty with that country; the dealer is wanted in Tamil Nadu, the U.S., and Germany

title: Power demand increases to 5,200 MW; system to be in place to alert public on power outages from Thursday, says Minister
content: Sunny Joseph says electricity consumption has increased significantly this month due to the hot and humid conditions prevailing in the State, exacerbated by the El Niño phenomenon in the Pacific

title: On marital rape, Supreme Court asks if courts can prosecute what State does not define as ‘rape’
content: While Justice Bagchi agreed that a “person in a matrimony subjected to involuntary sexual intercourse is definitely a victim”, he said “the question before us is whether the State defines it as ‘rape’ or not”.

title: Three Bank of Baroda officials held for gold-loan racket in Jangareddygudem
content: Then branch manager, joint manager and credit officer arrested after appraiser’s arrest; police say original ornaments in lockers were replaced with fakes and 4.12 kg of gold and ₹10 lakh recovered

title: Debutants face off in low-stakes Ayyappankkavu bypoll in Kochi
content: In the 76-member Kochi Corporation council, now reduced to 75 following the vacancy in Ayyappankkavu, the UDF commands the support of 47 members, including an Independent

title: Manohar asks Jana Sena cadre to prepare for local body elections in Andhra Pradesh
content: Ensure the party’s victory wherever it enters the electoral fray, says the PAC chief, while making it clear that matters relating to seat sharing will remain within the party president’s purview

title: UDF, LDF declare candidates for Kuttichira bypoll in Kozhikode
content: The seat fell vacant after Fathima Thahiliya, the incumbent councillor belonging to the IUML, resigned from her post following her election to the Assembly from the Perambra constituency in 2026

title: Access to information is a fundamental right of every citizen: Keralam Information Commissioner
content: T.K. Ramakrishnan calls for timely disclosure of information and better file management in government offices

title: CET: 24,283 unallocated engineering seats handed over to colleges
content: Apart from engineering, nursing had the highest number of vacant seats. Of 36,238 nursing seats, only 13,407 were allotted, leaving 22,832 seats unallocated, he said.

title: Hassan panel records Ramya Haridas’ statement in the late-night affray controversy in  Keralam
content: “I gave the M.M. Hassan Commission an honest account of what transpired and the circumstances that precipitated the incident. I hope and believe the commission will reach a just conclusion,” MLA tells reporters

title: Andhra Pradesh pushes ‘One Water’ vision at IFAT India 2026
content: State official calls for a shift to circular water management, with wastewater reuse, climate resilience and integrated urban planning at the core of future-ready cities.

title: Karnataka government’s initial estimate of drought-related losses pegged at ₹18,000 crore
content: Karnataka is preparing to submit its first memorandum to the Centre seeking financial help in the next two to three days

title: Severe rainfall deficit impacts Kharif farming in Markapuram
content: The district has received only 108.6 mm rainfall against the normal 228.4 mm from June 1, representing a 52.5% deficit;  kharif coverage falls to 21.09%, compared with 79% last year

title: Gujarat team appreciates APCNF natural farming model in Andhra Pradesh
content: Delegation sees healthier crops, greater biodiversity and improved income opportunities during field visits in Guntur district

title: In Bengaluru, many waste collectors not paid for four months
content: This comes even as Greater Bengaluru Development Minister Krishna Byre Gowda recently pointed out absenteeism among pourakarmikas who sweep the streets, drawing the ire of both pourakarmikas and waste collectors, who have demanded an apology.

title: Science and spirituality exhibition draws 5,000 visitors in Guntur
content: Students of Sathya Sai schools explain exhibits highlighting spiritual wisdom, traditional practices and human values

title: 177 Velampeta families to get flats where their huts stand;  ₹28.44 crore slum redevelopment begins in Visakhapatnam
content: Minister P. Narayana lays the foundation stone for the State’s first in-situ slum redevelopment, to be built in nine months with shear-wall technology; each family gets ₹3,000 a month in rent meanwhile, and residents who have waited decades say it feels like a dream

title: New satellite images show major construction surge at Iran’s Pickaxe nuke site
content: Construction activity has significantly increased at Iran's underground Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site this year.  The United States is developing new weapons to target deeply buried facilities.  President Trump has repeatedly threatened strikes on the heavily fortified Iranian location.  The US military maintains operational plans for potential strikes against the site.  This renewed scrutiny occurs as the wider US-Iran conflict intensifies.

title: 'That was some tennis!': Sachin Tendulkar in awe of Shelton’s epic win over Alcaraz
content: Ben Shelton triumphed over Carlos Alcaraz in a thrilling five-set clash during the US Open quarter-finals. After an exhausting battle that stretched over four hours, Shelton emerged victorious, ending Alcaraz's impressive Grand Slam winning streak and title defense. Notably, this victory marked Shelton's first against a top-three ranked player, proving his prowess on the court, especially as Alcaraz returned from a layoff due to a wrist injury.

title: 86-year-old father alleged son forced him out; HC orders son to vacate home
content: When an 86-year-old man bought several parcels of land in his youngest son's name and let him stay with him in the family's ancestral house in Odisha, he did not expect their relationship to eventually turn bad.

title: Apple Store goes down ahead of iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max & iPhone Duo launch
content: Apple's online store is offline ahead of its September special event.  The company is expected to unveil the iPhone eighteen Pro and Pro Max.  New Apple Watch Series twelve and Ultra four models are also anticipated.  The first foldable iPhone Duo and AirPods five are likely announcements.  The online store will update with new products after the presentation.

title: Rs 500 notes in kalakand boxes? Viral video triggers vote-for-cash row in Alwar
content: A video showing kalakand boxes with cash has gone viral before Alwar municipal polling.  Locals reported a car seen unloading boxes around 1 am in the Diwakari area.  Occupants allegedly fled after residents gathered and stopped the vehicle.  The Congress candidate denied the video, calling it a defamation attempt.  The forest minister stated the administration is investigating the circulating video.

title: 1980s AI photo trend: 11 ChatGPT prompts to turn photos into retro Bollywood looks
content: Users are transforming photos into 1980s Bollywood styles using ChatGPT.  This trend recreates vintage movie hero and heroine looks with specific prompts.  It allows for creating magazine covers and wedding album pictures easily.  Detailed prompts ensure authentic hairstyles, clothing, and lighting effects.  Users should check AI creations before sharing them online.

title: ‘Wanted to teach him a lesson’: Accused on assault that killed Delhi musician
content: Seven men and a juvenile were arrested for the alleged killing of Chongtham Vikram Singh.  The accused reportedly assaulted the musician after he objected to noise outside his home.  Singh, a musician, died hours after the assault due to internal injuries.  Police are investigating all aspects, including a potential racial angle in the incident.  The North Eastern Students' Organisation demanded a swift and impartial probe into the matter.

title: Missouri family rejected $238,000 for its land; court awarded them $2.1 million
content: A Missouri family's 15-acre property, bought in 1904, became the centre of a long eminent domain dispute after St. Louis County acquired it for a highway project. A jury valued the land at $1.3 million, while the court added $650,000 in heritage value and interest, taking the judgment to about $2.1 million. The Missouri Supreme Court later upheld the award.

title: Couple bought a broken Eichler home; now it’s worth $2.75 million
content: A magnificent example of midcentury modern architecture, this rare 1971 Eichler home in San Anselmo is listed at $2.75 million. Boasting four bedrooms, it has been tastefully renovated since its acquisition in 2015, showcasing an inviting indoor-outdoor aesthetic, a contemporary kitchen, and a sparkling pool. This home blends vibrant living spaces, making it perfect for families and older adults seeking style and comfort.

title: iPhone event today: How to watch launch of iPhone 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max & Ultra
content: Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event today will unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. The company's first foldable iPhone, possibly named iPhone Ultra, is also expected. New Apple Watch and AirPods models are anticipated alongside potential smart-home products. The event begins at 10:30 pm IST and will be streamed online. Preorders for new iPhones may start September 12, with sales on September 18.

title: Mammootty and Dulquer lived in this Kochi home for 12 years; now you can book it
content: Mammootty's former Kochi home is now a boutique villa for guests.  The property offers a glimpse into the star's personal life and interests.  Rooms are named after family members, reflecting their individual personalities.  A private theatre showcases Mammootty's extensive DVD collection and cinematic journey.  This unique villa provides an intimate experience beyond the actor's on-screen persona.

title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen’s $700m fortune: Why did their donations face scrutiny?
content: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen's Luz Foundation has recently drawn attention due to its donation practices from 2007 to 2019, supporting a range of environmental and humanitarian projects. In a bid for greater impact, Gisele later founded the Luz Alliance Fund, which played a crucial role in aiding disaster recovery in Brazil after the devastating floods. Both continue their philanthropic endeavors with various partnerships.

title: Ben Shelton and Trinity Rodman: How did their partnership fuel his rise?
content: Ben Shelton’s tennis rise has been shaped by patience, family and strong support around him. His father, Bryan Shelton, let him choose tennis before helping coach him through college. Now, girlfriend Trinity Rodman brings her own experience as an elite athlete to their relationship. Shelton says her understanding helps him handle both the difficult moments and the biggest wins.

title: Nepal’s flood bill could hit $5 billion. Where will the money come from?
content: Following the catastrophic floods, Nepal is staring down an enormous reconstruction cost running into billions. To restore infrastructure and homes effectively, both local resources and international assistance will play pivotal roles. The nation is actively pursuing funding opportunities with development banks and climate finance, emphasizing the importance of resilient rebuilding strategies for securing its long-term future.

title: 3 trucks of debris, 1 missing wall: How renovation doomed Delhi PG building
content: Delhi Police investigation revealed renovation work weakened the Satya Niketan building structure.  Renovation involved levelling the basement and removing a ground floor wall for a shop.  A labour contractor was arrested and stated Mahesh Gupta paid him daily for the work.  The building's paying guest operator was also arrested for negligence.  Seven people died after the five-storey building collapsed on September 6.

title: Father-in-law must 'quit politics': Mayawati's condition for Akash's big role
content: BSP chief Mayawati stated Ashok Siddharth must retire from politics for Akash Anand's return.  Akash Anand was removed from national convener and needs more maturity.  The party will consider Akash Anand's responsibilities after Siddharth's complete political exit.  Mayawati also readmitted expelled leaders and hinted at Ishan Anand's new party role.  These developments precede upcoming assembly elections in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh.

title: Gulzar Singh's suicide case: Rahul demands Punjab finance min's resignation
content: Rahul Gandhi has called for the resignation of Punjab minister Harpal Singh Cheema amidst ongoing concerns surrounding the death of Gulzar Singh. The Congress leader emphasized the need for a thorough investigation and cautioned Dalit communities about the potential misuse of power by the AAP government. Family members of Gulzar Singh have accused officials of harassment and making casteist remarks following their inquiries.

title: Vijay's TVK, its allies form Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance
content: The TVK-led alliance has been named the Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance. Leaders described the new front as an ideological group beyond electoral politics. This alliance aims to fight communal forces in Tamil Nadu and across the country. The upcoming bypolls in Dharapuram and Maduranthagam will be its first electoral test. The alliance will cover Tamil Nadu and Puducherry with Vijay as its leader.

title: Iraq caught in US-Iran crossfire as Baghdad pushes to disarm powerful militias
content: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi faces pressure to disarm Shi'ite militias.  Several powerful groups resist handing over their weapons to the state.  This standoff creates significant security and political challenges for the government.  The situation is complicated by ongoing regional tensions between Iran and the United States.  US-led coalition forces are scheduled to withdraw from Iraq by September 30.

title: Watch: Thar goes on rampage in Bhopal, smashes cars as women, kids flee
content: A Thar SUV caused panic in Soumya Fortune Heritage colony on Tuesday night. The vehicle rammed several parked cars and smashed through an exit gate. It also drove towards women and children, forcing them to flee for safety. The driver, who frequently visited the colony, then fled the scene. Police are investigating the incident and tracing the vehicle's driver.

title: ‘Making memes’: Chidambaram says Gen Z having last laugh over PM’s ‘naraaz fufa’ jibe
content: Congress leader P Chidambaram proudly embraced the 'Dimagi Naxal' label given by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He also dismissed the 'Naraaz Fufa' remark as meaningless and lacking substance. Chidambaram noted that these comments have sparked widespread discussion and memes online. Prime Minister Modi had urged identifying and isolating those with an ideological Naxal mindset. The exchange highlights ongoing political sparring between the BJP and Congress parties.

title: 'No one even told us': Noskova questions roof closure delay after loss to Sabalenka
content: Sabalenka was leading 5-4 in the third set when Noskova stepped up to serve. At that point, most of the court was still in sunlight. By the time Noskova played her first point, the shadow had moved close to the middle of the court. After she won that point, almost the entire court was in shade when the next point started.

title: Red Fort blast case: NIA names Umer Un Nabi ‘operational in-charge’ of terror module
content: The chargesheet alleges that Nabi, also known as Pinda and Rahul Bhat, had been working since early 2022 to revive the dormant module and build a network of radicalised persons for carrying out terrorist activities against the Indian State.

title: School holiday September 10: Are schools closed tomorrow due to rain?
content: Schools across most parts of India are expected to remain open on September 10, 2026, despite heavy rainfall warnings in several regions. No nationwide closure has been announced, although district authorities may suspend classes where flooding, waterlogging or unsafe travel conditions pose risks. Parents and students have been advised to follow official local and school-specific updates.

title: Chinese-origin Type 59 tank explodes during exercise in Bangladesh, 2 killed: Report
content: A Chinese-origin Type 59 tank exploded during a live-fire exercise in Hathazari, Chattogram. The incident tragically killed two Bangladesh Army soldiers and seriously injured one officer. The injured officer was airlifted to a military hospital in Dhaka for advanced medical treatment. An investigation has been ordered by the Bangladesh Army to determine the exact cause of this accident.

title: Govt-owned fuel retailers lose Rs 5 per litre on petrol as oil tops $100 per barrel
content: Fuel retailers are experiencing substantial losses per litre on petrol and diesel, as international crude oil prices have recently surpassed one hundred dollars a barrel. India relies on imports for over eighty-eight percent of its crude oil consumption. Despite these soaring prices, retail rates for petrol and diesel have remained stagnant for over three months.

title: Brics Summit: Delhi on high alert with 4,800 cops, 35+ roads face curbs
content: As Delhi gears up for the 18th Brics Summit from September 11 to 13, heightened security protocols have been put in place. Over 4,800 traffic police will oversee the movements of VVIPs and manage traffic diversions. This summit, held at Bharat Mandapam, celebrates two decades of Brics and welcomes foreign leaders and dignitaries from its newly expanded eleven-member coalition.

title: 5 ‘lost’ baby orangutans found in Odisha forest
content: Five juvenile orangutans were discovered abandoned in a forest in Odisha's Balasore district. Forest officials suspect a transoceanic trafficking network smuggled the young apes into India. Villagers alerted the forest department after spotting the orangutans dangling from tree branches. The animals were safely secured without the use of tranquilizers by forest personnel. A Wildlife Crime Control Bureau team is investigating the origin of these exotic animals.

title: Watch: PM Modi’s ‘naraaz fufa’ jibe follows Rahul Gandhi to Rae Bareli
content: Rahul Gandhi arrived in Rae Bareli for a two-day constituency visit. He chaired a key DISHA meeting to review central scheme progress. Gandhi also met with various professional groups and traders. He will inaugurate development works funded by his MP funds. The Congress leader will also visit flood-hit areas in Shivgarh and Maharajganj.

title: Watch: DU students raise ‘VC go back, sharam karo’ slogan at campus event days
content: Students protested Delhi University Vice-Chancellor Yogesh Singh during a campus event.  Slogans were raised demanding accountability after a recent building collapse.  The protest occurred days after several students died in the Satya Niketan PG building collapse.  Student groups continue to question safety and accommodation following the tragedy.  A march also demanded structural audits and accountability for the incident.

title: ‘Can’t live here anymore’: Collapse sends Satya Niketan students packing
content: In light of a nearby building collapse, students from Satya Niketan are vacating their rooms, prompted by urgent safety concerns regarding nearby structures. While some are heading back to their hometowns, others are securing temporary housing within colleges. Property owners are taking down PG signboards to avoid scrutiny, and volunteers are stepping in to help with rescue operations and to provide essential supplies to those affected.

title: Fuel shortage & blackout: How Cuba’s energy crisis is disrupting daily life
content: Cuba faces a severe crisis with prolonged power outages and fuel shortages affecting daily life.  Water supplies are increasingly unstable, creating significant health risks for citizens.  United States energy pressure on Cuba has intensified, impacting vital import companies.  This situation stems from a long-standing dispute between Washington and Havana since 1959.  Current US policies under President Trump have further tightened restrictions on Cuba's energy sector.

title: Cabinet approves Rs 20,804 crore railway projects across nine states
content: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) has sanctioned eight railway projects exceeding Rs 20,000 crore. With an addition of nearly 1,200 kilometers to the Indian Railways network, these projects will substantially enhance freight capabilities—47 million tonnes from five southern projects and 65 million tonnes from three situated in eastern and central India. These upgrades are crucial steps towards improving transport efficiency and achieving notable reductions in carbon emissions.

title: Israeli Foreign Minister Says No Plans To "Expel Or Deport" Anyone From Gaza
content: Several Israeli cabinet members have spoken of plans to remove all two million people from war-ravaged Gaza, although they largely cast the initiative as voluntary, saying that Palestinians want to leave and are prevented by the militant group Hamas.

title: Class 3 Student Dies After Falling From Moving School Van In Madhya Pradesh
content: The accident occurred within the jurisdiction of the Vijayraghavgarh police station when the Class 3 student was returning home from school.

content: According to the anti-terror agency NIA, the Hyundai i20 car used in the blast was effectively a Vehicle-Borne Improvised Explosive Device (VBIED).

content: Radha Mohan Mishra, who was arrested in June, had approached the High Court seeking bail on medical grounds.

title: 58-Year-Old British Tourist Arrested For Spitting On Turkish Flag
content: The 58-year-old tourist argued with staff in a hotel then allegedly turned and spat on a flag hanging in the lobby, DHA and IHA news agencies reported, without saying exactly when it happened.

title: Eiffel Tower Reopens After Hindu Group Apologises For Removing Women Staff
content: The group, known as BAPS, is a worldwide religious and civic organisation within the Swaminarayan sect, a branch of Hinduism. It has been holding celebrations to mark the inauguration of a traditional Hindu stone temple in the French capital.

content: The commission's move comes amid concerns over the alleged availability and promotion of child sexual exploitation material through online platforms.

title: Iron Rods Pierce Karnataka Bus After Tractor Collision, Driver Dies On Spot
content: The Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) bus rammed into the tractor from behind on a stretch in Nagamangala taluk. The impact caused the iron rods and bars being carried on the tractor to pierce the bus.

content: The British navy-affiliated UKMTO said it was unable to confirm any casualties or environmental impact.

title: Putin, Trump Discussed Potential Trilateral Meeting With Xi Jinping: Kremlin
content: Asked whether Trump and Putin discussed the idea of a trilateral meeting in Shenzhen during their phone call on Tuesday, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said, "Undoubtedly."

title: Names Of 3 Afghans Found On Jharkhand Voter List During SIR
content: The Election Commission has removed the names from the list and issued instructions to investigate the matter thoroughly.

title: Blog: Non-Veg Is Not A Treat During Durga Puja. In Bengal, It Is Bhog
content: In Bengal, Maa Durga does not come as a guest who must be wrapped in holiness. She comes as a daughter returning to her father's house.

title: "All Treated Equally": Supreme Court Over Plea On Case Against Rahul Gandhi
content: On August 4 last year, the top court had stayed further proceedings in the complaint case pending before a Lucknow court till the next date of hearing.

title: Massive blast tears through Syria weapons depot, 14 killed in Idlib - video
content: the blast took place near Sarmada, close to the Turkish border . the site had been used to store weapons and ammunition left from the uprising and subsequent civil war . scale of the blast was captured in footage circulated after the incident, showing a large column of black smoke rising from the area .

title: ‘Can’t allow Kafkaite trial’: HC to Centre on LOC disclosure against person
content: the court observed that a person against whom a look-out circular (LOC) is issued must be made aware of it . this is because he/she can either choose to abide by the proceedings or take appropriate action against them, the court said . the country does not follow a ‘Kafkaite trial’ but operates strictly in accordance with the Constitution .
